quote: Interested in quantifying the effect of patterns in the training data on agent performance... we use the following metrics: • Task Completion (TC)... • Overshoot Rate (OSR)... • Orientation... Precision, Recall and F1 scores.

we use the following metrics: • Task Completion (TC) represents the percentage of successful navigation instances among all navigation instances in the test set . • Overshoot Rate (OSR) is the rate at which the agent reaches a destination but fails to stop at the destination. • Orientation assesses how capable the model is in orienting the agent towards the correct direction in the beginning of the navigation. We use Precision, Recall and F1 scores.
